change_summary: Replace large XBLOCK autotune configs (512/1024/2048 with num_warps 4/8) with small XBLOCK configs (128/256/512 with num_warps 2/4/8) to increase blocks/SM from 16 to 32 for better latency hiding, and fix the hardcoded grid size bug by using lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(xnumel, meta['XBLOCK']),) so autotune-selected XBLOCK actually drives the launch grid.
